blueprints.docsMarkdown:
## Doorbell Multi-Speaker TTS Announcement
Doorbell Multi-Speaker TTS Announcement

[![Import blueprint](https://my.home-assistant.io/badges/blueprint_import.svg)](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/blueprint_import/?blueprint_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2F0libote%2FHA-BPs%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fblueprints%2Fdoorbell-announcement.yaml)

Manual import URL:

```text
https://github.com/0libote/HA-BPs/blob/main/blueprints/doorbell-announcement.yaml
```

This blueprint announces a press from any selected doorbell binary sensor on
one or more media players. The TTS entity, message, announcement volume, cleanup
delay and volume afterwards are configurable. Optional conditions can suppress
announcements, and optional extra actions can add notifications or light effects.

### Configure

1. Import the blueprint and select **Create automation**.
2. Select the doorbell binary sensor or sensors.
3. Select a `tts` entity and the media players that should announce the press.
4. Set the message, volumes and cleanup delay.
5. Optionally add conditions or extra actions, then save and test.

The blueprint calls each speaker separately so an error from one speaker does
not prevent the remaining speakers from being attempted. It ignores additional
doorbell presses until the current cleanup delay has finished.

### Troubleshooting

- No announcement: confirm the doorbell entity changes to `on`, and test the
  selected `tts` entity with the speaker in **Developer tools > Actions**.
- Message is cut off: increase **Delay Before Cleanup** or disable **Stop
  Playback After Announcement**.
- Wrong volume afterwards: change **Volume After Announcement**. This mirrors
  the original automation's fixed post-announcement volume rather than trying
  to resume each speaker's earlier media session.

[View the YAML](doorbell-announcement.yaml)
blueprints.rawYaml:
blueprint:
  name: Doorbell - Multi-Speaker TTS Announcement
  author: 0libote
  description: |
    Announces a doorbell press on one or more media players.

    Created by @0libote
    GitHub: https://github.com/0libote/HA-BPs

    Behaviour:
    - Starts when any selected doorbell binary sensor turns on.
    - Sets every selected speaker to the announcement volume.
    - Speaks the configured message on each speaker through the selected TTS
      entity.
    - After the configured delay, sets the speakers to the chosen normal volume
      and can stop any remaining announcement playback.
    - Supports optional conditions and extra actions.
    - Ignores another press while the current announcement run is active.

  domain: automation
  source_url: https://github.com/0libote/HA-BPs/blob/main/blueprints/doorbell-announcement.yaml

  homeassistant:
    min_version: 2025.7.0

  input:
    doorbell:
      name: Doorbell
      icon: mdi:doorbell
      collapsed: false
      input:
        doorbell_sensors:
          name: Doorbell Sensors
          description: Select one or more binary sensors that turn on when the doorbell is pressed.
          selector:
            entity:
              multiple: true
              filter:
                - domain: binary_sensor

        extra_conditions:
          name: Extra Conditions
          description: Optional conditions such as quiet hours, presence, or house mode.
          default: []
          selector:
            condition:

    announcement:
      name: Announcement
      icon: mdi:account-voice
      collapsed: false
      input:
        tts_entity:
          name: Text-to-Speech Entity
          description: Select the TTS entity that should generate the announcement.
          selector:
            entity:
              filter:
                - domain: tts

        media_players:
          name: Speakers
          description: Select one or more media players for the announcement.
          selector:
            entity:
              multiple: true
              filter:
                - domain: media_player

        message:
          name: Message
          default: Someone is at the door.
          selector:
            text:
              multiline: true

        announcement_volume:
          name: Announcement Volume
          default: 0.6
          selector:
            number:
              min: 0
              max: 1
              step: 0.05
              mode: slider

    cleanup:
      name: After the Announcement
      icon: mdi:volume-minus
      collapsed: false
      input:
        cleanup_delay:
          name: Delay Before Cleanup
          description: Allow enough time for the message to finish before cleanup.
          default:
            hours: 0
            minutes: 0
            seconds: 5
          selector:
            duration:

        normal_volume:
          name: Volume After Announcement
          description: Volume applied to every selected speaker after the delay.
          default: 0.3
          selector:
            number:
              min: 0
              max: 1
              step: 0.05
              mode: slider

        stop_after_announcement:
          name: Stop Playback After Announcement
          description: Stop any announcement audio still playing after the cleanup delay.
          default: true
          selector:
            boolean:

        extra_actions:
          name: Extra Actions
          description: Optional actions to run after speaker cleanup, such as a notification or light flash.
          default: []
          selector:
            action:

variables:
  speakers: !input media_players
  announcement_message: !input message
  announcement_level: !input announcement_volume
  normal_level: !input normal_volume
  should_stop: !input stop_after_announcement

trigger:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input doorbell_sensors
    to: "on"

condition:
  - condition: and
    conditions: !input extra_conditions

action:
  - action: media_player.volume_set
    continue_on_error: true
    target:
      entity_id: "{{ speakers }}"
    data:
      volume_level: "{{ announcement_level }}"

  - repeat:
      for_each: "{{ speakers }}"
      sequence:
        - action: tts.speak
          continue_on_error: true
          target:
            entity_id: !input tts_entity
          data:
            cache: false
            media_player_entity_id: "{{ repeat.item }}"
            message: "{{ announcement_message }}"

  - delay: !input cleanup_delay

  - action: media_player.volume_set
    continue_on_error: true
    target:
      entity_id: "{{ speakers }}"
    data:
      volume_level: "{{ normal_level }}"

  - if:
      - condition: template
        value_template: "{{ should_stop }}"
    then:
      - action: media_player.media_stop
        continue_on_error: true
        target:
          entity_id: "{{ speakers }}"

  - choose: []
    default: !input extra_actions

mode: single
max_exceeded: silent

blueprints.name: IKEA BILRESA Scroll Wheel - 3 Light Presets
blueprints.author: 0libote
blueprints.description:
Flexible light control for the IKEA BILRESA scroll wheel remote via Matter.

Created by @0libote
GitHub: https://github.com/0libote/HA-BPs

Setup is top-down: pick the 9 remote event entities, pick the lights for
each preset, then tune the shared wheel and colour feel once.

Each of the three physical BILRESA presets can:
- Control its own set of lights.
- Be disabled.
- Duplicate another preset's lights and colours.
- Share one brightness step, range and transition.
- Share one centre-button layout (Tap = Colour / Hold = Power, or reversed).
- Use its own ordered colour list with Home Assistant's RGB colour picker.
- Reorder colours by dragging them in the blueprint editor.

Presets 2 and 3 duplicate Preset 1 by default, so a single room works after
configuring Preset 1 only. Switch a preset to a custom profile when it
should control different lights or cycle different colours.

Wheel movement uses Matter's totalNumberOfPressesCounted value, so a quick
multi-detent spin is applied as one larger brightness change. Brightness is
clamped to the configured minimum and maximum. Scrolling right while the
preset's lights are off turns them on at the minimum brightness. Tapping
for colour while off turns them on with the first colour.

Updating from an older version resets per-preset tuning to the new shared
Wheel and Colour settings. Re-check those once after updating.

Important Matter limitation:
If the BILRESA itself aborts an over-limit multi-press sequence and sends no
completed event, a blueprint cannot recover that missing movement.

## IKEA BILRESA Scroll Wheel
IKEA BILRESA Scroll Wheel

[![Import blueprint](https://my.home-assistant.io/badges/blueprint_import.svg)](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/blueprint_import/?blueprint_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2F0libote%2FHA-BPs%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fblueprints%2Fbilresa-scroll-wheel.yaml)

Manual import URL:

```text
https://github.com/0libote/HA-BPs/blob/main/blueprints/bilresa-scroll-wheel.yaml
```

This blueprint turns the three physical BILRESA presets into light profiles
with one shared wheel feel. Each preset keeps its own lights and ordered colour
list, or duplicates another preset. Brightness step, range, transitions and the
centre-button layout are shared so there is far less to tune.

Presets 2 and 3 duplicate Preset 1 by default, so a single room works after
configuring Preset 1 only.

### Before you start

- Pair the BILRESA with Home Assistant through Matter.
- On the device page, identify the three `event` entities for each preset:
  right/brighter, left/dimmer and centre push.
- Confirm that turning or pressing the control updates those event entities.

### Configure

1. Import the blueprint and select **Create automation**.
2. In **Remote buttons**, select the 9 event entities, three per preset.
3. In **Lights and presets**, select Preset 1 lights. Keep Presets 2 and 3
   duplicating Preset 1, or switch them to custom lights or disabled.
4. In **Wheel and centre button**, set the shared brightness step, limits,
   transition and tap/hold layout.
5. In **Colours**, order Preset 1 colours. Add custom lists for Presets 2 and
   3 only when they use custom profiles.
6. Save the automation and test tap, hold and both wheel directions.

Scrolling right while a preset's lights are off turns them on at the minimum
brightness. Colour while off turns them on with the first colour.

Fast wheel movement uses Matter's `totalNumberOfPressesCounted` value. If the
device itself aborts an over-limit multi-press and publishes no completed event,
Home Assistant has no movement for the blueprint to recover.

Updating from an older version resets per-preset tuning to the new shared
Wheel and Colour settings. Re-check those once after updating.

### Troubleshooting

- No response: watch the selected event entity in **Developer tools > States**
  and confirm it updates when the control is used.
- Wrong direction or button: re-check the three event entities selected for that
  preset.
- Centre button does nothing: check the shared centre-button layout. Tap and
  hold are matched permissively across Matter tap/hold event names.
- Unexpected brightness: check the shared minimum, maximum and per-detent
  step before changing the automation logic.

              fields:
                name:
                  label: Name
                  required: true
                  selector:
                    text:
                colour:
                  label: Colour
                  required: true
                  selector:
                    color_rgb:

        colour_transition:
          name: Colour Transition
          default: 0.5
          selector:
            number:
              min: 0
              max: 5
              step: 0.1
              unit_of_measurement: s
              mode: slider


# ==============================================================
# AUTOMATION MODE
# ==============================================================

mode: queued
max: 10
max_exceeded: silent


# ==============================================================
# TRIGGERS
# ==============================================================

trigger:

  # Preset 1
  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input button_1
    not_from:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    id: preset1_right

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input button_2
    not_from:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    id: preset1_left

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input button_3
    not_from:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    id: preset1_centre

  # Preset 2
  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input button_4
    not_from:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    id: preset2_right

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input button_5
    not_from:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    id: preset2_left

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input button_6
    not_from:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    id: preset2_centre

  # Preset 3
  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input button_7
    not_from:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    id: preset3_right

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input button_8
    not_from:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    id: preset3_left

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input button_9
    not_from:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    not_to:
      - unknown
      - unavailable
    id: preset3_centre


# ==============================================================
# ACTIONS
# ==============================================================

action:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # RAW INPUT VALUES
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  - variables:

      p1_mode: !input preset_1_mode
      p2_mode: !input preset_2_mode
      p3_mode: !input preset_3_mode

      p1_lights: !input preset_1_lights
      p2_lights: !input preset_2_lights
      p3_lights: !input preset_3_lights

      brightness_step: !input brightness_step
      brightness_min: !input brightness_min
      brightness_max: !input brightness_max
      brightness_transition: !input brightness_transition
      centre_layout: !input centre_layout

      p1_colour_presets: !input preset_1_colour_presets
      p2_colour_presets: !input preset_2_colour_presets
      p3_colour_presets: !input preset_3_colour_presets
      colour_transition: !input colour_transition

      # Matter event type. Centre-button matching is permissive on purpose:
      # Matter integrations report tap/hold with different names, so any event
      # containing "long"/"hold" counts as a hold and any press/click/tap
      # counts as a tap. Anything else is ignored.
      event_type: >-
        {{
          trigger.to_state.attributes.event_type
          if trigger.to_state is not none
          and trigger.to_state.attributes.event_type is defined
          else ''
        }}

      # BILRESA reports a burst of wheel detents in this attribute. Clamped so
      # one spin cannot jump further than intended by an extreme value.
      scroll_clicks: >-
        {{
          [[
            trigger.to_state.attributes.totalNumberOfPressesCounted
            | default(1, true)
            | int(1),
            1
          ] | max, 25] | min
          if trigger.to_state is not none
          else 1
        }}

      legacy_colour_order:
        - warm_white
        - red
        - orange
        - yellow
        - green
        - cyan
        - blue
        - purple
        - pink
        - cool_white

      legacy_colour_map:
        warm_white: [255, 166, 87]
        red: [255, 0, 0]
        orange: [255, 80, 0]
        yellow: [255, 200, 0]
        green: [0, 255, 0]
        cyan: [0, 255, 255]
        blue: [0, 80, 255]
        purple: [160, 0, 255]
        pink: [255, 0, 120]
        cool_white: [220, 235, 255]


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # WHICH PHYSICAL PRESET FIRED, AND WHICH PROFILE DOES IT USE?
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  - variables:

      event_type_lower: "{{ (event_type | string | lower) }}"

      trigger_enabled: >-
        {{
          (
            trigger.id in ['preset1_right', 'preset1_left', 'preset1_centre']
            and p1_mode != 'disabled'
          )
          or
          (
            trigger.id in ['preset2_right', 'preset2_left', 'preset2_centre']
            and p2_mode != 'disabled'
          )
          or
          (
            trigger.id in ['preset3_right', 'preset3_left', 'preset3_centre']
            and p3_mode != 'disabled'
          )
        }}

      source_preset: >-
        {% if trigger.id in ['preset1_right', 'preset1_left', 'preset1_centre'] %}
          1

        {% elif trigger.id in ['preset2_right', 'preset2_left', 'preset2_centre'] %}
          {% if p2_mode == 'duplicate_preset_1' %}
            1
          {% else %}
            2
          {% endif %}

        {% else %}
          {% if p3_mode == 'duplicate_preset_1' %}
            1

          {% elif p3_mode == 'duplicate_preset_2' %}
            {% if p2_mode == 'duplicate_preset_1' %}
              1
            {% else %}
              2
            {% endif %}

          {% else %}
            3
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}

  - variables:

      # A preset that duplicates a disabled profile must also do nothing.
      # This is a separate step so source_preset from above is already set.
      source_enabled: >-
        {{
          (
            source_preset | int == 1
            and p1_mode != 'disabled'
          )
          or
          (
            source_preset | int == 2
            and p2_mode != 'disabled'
            and p2_mode != 'duplicate_preset_1'
          )
          or
          (
            source_preset | int == 3
            and p3_mode != 'disabled'
          )
        }}


  # Disabled presets stop here.
  - condition: template
    value_template: "{{ trigger_enabled | bool and source_enabled | bool }}"


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # EFFECTIVE PROFILE SETTINGS
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  - variables:

      target_lights: >-
        {{
          p1_lights
          if source_preset | int == 1
          else p2_lights
          if source_preset | int == 2
          else p3_lights
        }}

      chosen_colours: >-
        {{
          p1_colour_presets
          if source_preset | int == 1
          else p2_colour_presets
          if source_preset | int == 2
          else p3_colour_presets
        }}


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # DERIVED RUNTIME VALUES
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  - variables:

      on_lights: >-
        {{
          expand(target_lights)
          | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on')
          | map(attribute='entity_id')
          | list
        }}

      # New configurations contain ordered objects:
      #   - name: Red
      #     colour: [255, 0, 0]
      #
      # Older configurations contain a list of preset-name strings. They are
      # normalised here using the old fixed order, preserving old behaviour.
      active_colours: >-
        {% set ns = namespace(items=[]) %}

        {% if chosen_colours | count > 0 and chosen_colours[0] is string %}

          {% for colour_name in legacy_colour_order %}
            {% if colour_name in chosen_colours and colour_name in legacy_colour_map %}
              {% set ns.items = ns.items + [legacy_colour_map[colour_name]] %}
            {% endif %}
          {% endfor %}

        {% else %}

          {% for item in chosen_colours %}
            {% if
              item is mapping
              and item.colour is defined
              and item.colour | count == 3
            %}
              {% set ns.items = ns.items + [item.colour] %}
            {% endif %}
          {% endfor %}

        {% endif %}

        {{ ns.items }}

      centre_action: >-
        {% if 'long' in event_type_lower or 'hold' in event_type_lower %}
          {% if centre_layout == 'tap_power_hold_colour' %}
            colour
          {% else %}
            power
          {% endif %}
        {% elif 'press' in event_type_lower or 'click' in event_type_lower or 'tap' in event_type_lower or 'single' in event_type_lower or 'double' in event_type_lower or 'multi' in event_type_lower or 'initial' in event_type_lower or 'short' in event_type_lower %}
          {% if centre_layout == 'tap_power_hold_colour' %}
            power
          {% else %}
            colour
          {% endif %}
        {% else %}
          ignore
        {% endif %}


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # STALE MATTER EVENT PROTECTION
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Event entities update last_changed on every press. Queued wheel spins can
  # lag a few seconds behind real time, so the window is generous. Without it,
  # an old replayed state after a restart could toggle the lights.
  - condition: template
    value_template: >-
      {{
        trigger.to_state is not none
        and (now() - trigger.to_state.last_changed).total_seconds() < 30
      }}


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # ACTION ROUTING
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  - choose:

      # ========================================================
      # RIGHT - BRIGHTNESS UP
      # ========================================================
      - conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: >-
              {{
                trigger.id in ['preset1_right', 'preset2_right', 'preset3_right']
                and target_lights | count > 0
              }}
        sequence:
          - choose:

              # Lights are on: brighten the lights that are on.
              - conditions:
                  - condition: template
                    value_template: "{{ on_lights | count > 0 }}"
                sequence:
                  - repeat:
                      for_each: "{{ on_lights }}"
                      sequence:

                        - variables:
                            new_brightness_pct: >-
                              {% set current =
                                (state_attr(repeat.item, 'brightness') | int(1))
                                / 255 * 100
                              %}

                              {% set low =
                                [brightness_min | float, brightness_max | float] | min
                              %}

                              {% set high =
                                [brightness_min | float, brightness_max | float] | max
                              %}

                              {% set requested =
                                current
                                + (
                                  (brightness_step | float)
                                  * (scroll_clicks | int(1))
                                )
                              %}

                              {{
                                [
                                  high,
                                  [low, requested] | max
                                ]
                                | min
                                | round(0)
                                | int
                              }}

                        - action: light.turn_on
                          target:
                            entity_id: "{{ repeat.item }}"
                          data:
                            brightness_pct: "{{ new_brightness_pct }}"
                            transition: "{{ brightness_transition }}"

            # Everything is off: scrolling right wakes the preset at minimum.
            default:
              - variables:
                  wake_brightness_pct: >-
                    {% set low =
                      [brightness_min | float, brightness_max | float] | min
                    %}

                    {% set high =
                      [brightness_min | float, brightness_max | float] | max
                    %}

                    {{
                      [
                        high,
                        [low, brightness_min | float] | max
                      ]
                      | min
                      | round(0)
                      | int
                    }}
              - action: light.turn_on
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"
                data:
                  brightness_pct: "{{ wake_brightness_pct }}"
                  transition: "{{ brightness_transition }}"


      # ========================================================
      # LEFT - BRIGHTNESS DOWN
      # ========================================================
      - conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: >-
              {{
                trigger.id in ['preset1_left', 'preset2_left', 'preset3_left']
                and on_lights | count > 0
              }}
        sequence:
          - repeat:
              for_each: "{{ on_lights }}"
              sequence:

                - variables:
                    new_brightness_pct: >-
                      {% set current =
                        (state_attr(repeat.item, 'brightness') | int(255))
                        / 255 * 100
                      %}

                      {% set low =
                        [brightness_min | float, brightness_max | float] | min
                      %}

                      {% set high =
                        [brightness_min | float, brightness_max | float] | max
                      %}

                      {% set requested =
                        current
                        - (
                          (brightness_step | float)
                          * (scroll_clicks | int(1))
                        )
                      %}

                      {{
                        [
                          high,
                          [low, requested] | max
                        ]
                        | min
                        | round(0)
                        | int
                      }}

                - action: light.turn_on
                  target:
                    entity_id: "{{ repeat.item }}"
                  data:
                    brightness_pct: "{{ new_brightness_pct }}"
                    transition: "{{ brightness_transition }}"


      # ========================================================
      # CENTRE BUTTON - POWER
      # ========================================================
      - conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: >-
              {{
                trigger.id in ['preset1_centre', 'preset2_centre', 'preset3_centre']
                and centre_action == 'power'
                and target_lights | count > 0
              }}
        sequence:
          - choose:

              - conditions:
                  - condition: template
                    value_template: >-
                      {{
                        expand(target_lights)
                        | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on')
                        | list
                        | count > 0
                      }}
                sequence:
                  - action: light.turn_off
                    target:
                      entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"
                    data:
                      transition: "{{ brightness_transition }}"

            default:
              - action: light.turn_on
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"
                data:
                  transition: "{{ brightness_transition }}"


      # ========================================================
      # CENTRE BUTTON - COLOUR
      # ========================================================
      - conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: >-
              {{
                trigger.id in ['preset1_centre', 'preset2_centre', 'preset3_centre']
                and centre_action == 'colour'
                and target_lights | count > 0
                and active_colours | count > 0
              }}
        sequence:
          - choose:

              # Lights are on: advance from the closest colour.
              - conditions:
                  - condition: template
                    value_template: "{{ on_lights | count > 0 }}"
                sequence:

                  - variables:

                      reference_light: >-
                        {{ on_lights[0] }}

                      current_rgb: >-
                        {{ state_attr(reference_light, 'rgb_color') }}

                      next_rgb: >-
                        {% set ns = namespace(
                          best_index=-1,
                          best_distance=999999999
                        ) %}

                        {% if current_rgb is not none %}

                          {% for rgb in active_colours %}

                            {% set red_difference =
                              (current_rgb[0] | int)
                              -
                              (rgb[0] | int)
                            %}

                            {% set green_difference =
                              (current_rgb[1] | int)
                              -
                              (rgb[1] | int)
                            %}

                            {% set blue_difference =
                              (current_rgb[2] | int)
                              -
                              (rgb[2] | int)
                            %}

                            {% set distance =
                              (red_difference * red_difference)
                              +
                              (green_difference * green_difference)
                              +
                              (blue_difference * blue_difference)
                            %}

                            {% if distance < ns.best_distance %}
                              {% set ns.best_distance = distance %}
                              {% set ns.best_index = loop.index0 %}
                            {% endif %}

                          {% endfor %}

                        {% endif %}

                        {% if ns.best_index == -1 %}
                          {% set next_index = 0 %}
                        {% else %}
                          {% set next_index =
                            (ns.best_index + 1)
                            %
                            (active_colours | count)
                          %}
                        {% endif %}

                        {{ active_colours[next_index] }}

                  - action: light.turn_on
                    target:
                      entity_id: "{{ on_lights }}"
                    data:
                      rgb_color: "{{ next_rgb }}"
                      transition: "{{ colour_transition }}"

            # Everything is off: colour tap wakes the preset on the first colour.
            default:
              - action: light.turn_on
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"
                data:
                  rgb_color: "{{ active_colours[0] }}"
                  transition: "{{ colour_transition }}"

blueprints.description:
Smart motion lighting for IKEA MYGGSPRAY Matter-over-Thread sensors and
other Home Assistant motion detectors.

Created by @0libote
GitHub: https://github.com/0libote/HA-BPs

Behaviour:
- Starts when any selected motion detector reports motion, at least one
  selected illuminance sensor is below the chosen threshold, and every
  selected light is off and available.
- Motion-only detectors are supported; illuminance can be supplied by
  separate detectors that expose light-level entities.
- Sends brightness and colour in the same light.turn_on call, avoiding an
  intentional "turn on, then dim/recolour" sequence.
- Turns the lights back off after occupancy has stayed continuously clear
  for the configured time.
- Remembers each light's latest normal ON brightness/colour while idle and
  can restore that profile immediately before automatic switch-off.
- Manual/external OFF immediately releases the current motion-light session.
- Recovers from stale session locks when all target lights are already off.
- Cleans up after sensor/light faults and has a maximum-runtime failsafe.
- Supports extra user-defined activation conditions.

Previous-profile memory:
Home Assistant reports active brightness/colour attributes as null while a
light is off. Without requiring helpers, this blueprint keeps temporary
dynamic scenes whenever target lights are normally ON. Profile tracking is
locked while motion lighting owns the lights, so the automation profile
cannot overwrite the remembered normal profile.

Dynamic scenes are temporary. They are cleared by a Home Assistant restart
or scene reload and are relearned the next time each light is used normally.
If no profile has been learned yet, cleanup still turns the light off but
cannot pre-load its previous brightness/colour first.

Flash prevention:
Home Assistant cannot generically pre-stage brightness/colour while a light
is physically off. This blueprint therefore sends brightness and colour in
one turn_on command. A bulb that itself briefly recalls an old hardware
state before applying that command cannot be fully prevented by a blueprint.

## IKEA MYGGSPRAY Smart Motion Lights
IKEA MYGGSPRAY Smart Motion Lights

[![Import blueprint](https://my.home-assistant.io/badges/blueprint_import.svg)](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/blueprint_import/?blueprint_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2F0libote%2FHA-BPs%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fblueprints%2Fmyggspray-auto-lights.yaml)

Manual import URL:

```text
https://github.com/0libote/HA-BPs/blob/main/blueprints/myggspray-auto-lights.yaml
```

This blueprint starts a motion-lighting session when any selected motion
detector reports activity, at least one selected illuminance sensor says the
room is dark enough, and every selected light is off and available. Motion-only
detectors are supported because the illuminance entities are selected
separately. It can remember the latest normal light profile, restore it before
switch-off and clean up after manual changes, unavailable entities or an
overlong session.

### Before you start

- Pair the MYGGSPRAY with Home Assistant through Matter-over-Thread.
- Identify the occupancy or motion entities covering the area and at least one
  illuminance entity. They do not have to belong to the same devices.
- Make sure the target lights can be controlled normally from Home Assistant.

### Configure

1. Import the blueprint and select **Create automation**.
2. Select one or more motion/occupancy sensors, one or more illuminance sensors,
   and the target lights.
3. Choose the lux threshold, automation brightness and optional colour.
4. Set the clear delay and maximum session runtime.
5. Optionally add activation conditions, then save and test in a non-critical
   room first.

The remembered profiles use temporary dynamic scenes. A Home Assistant restart
or scene reload clears them; the blueprint learns them again the next time the
lights are used normally.

### Troubleshooting

- Motion does not start a session: check the current lux value and confirm every
  target light is both off and available.
- Lights turn off while part of the area is occupied: confirm every selected
  motion detector reports `on` while it detects activity. The clear delay starts
  only after all selected detectors report `off`.
- A previous profile is not restored: use the light normally while the motion
  session is idle so a fresh profile can be learned.
- A bulb briefly flashes an old colour: some bulbs recall their hardware state
  before applying Home Assistant's combined brightness and colour command. A
  generic blueprint cannot pre-stage a physically powered-off bulb.

[View the YAML](myggspray-auto-lights.yaml)

          description: Used only when Automation Colour is RGB colour.
          default: [255, 214, 170]
          selector:
            color_rgb:

        colour_temperature:
          name: White Colour Temperature
          description: Used only when Automation Colour is White colour temperature.
          default: 2700
          selector:
            color_temp:
              unit: kelvin
              min: 2000
              max: 6500

        turn_on_transition:
          name: Turn On Transition
          description: Zero is usually best for avoiding a visible ramp from an old state.
          default: 0
          selector:
            number:

              step: 0.1
              unit_of_measurement: s
              mode: slider

            minutes: 2

  target_lights: !input target_lights

  automation_colour_mode: !input colour_mode
  automation_rgb_colour: !input rgb_colour
  automation_colour_temperature: !input colour_temperature
  automation_turn_on_transition: !input turn_on_transition
  restore_previous_profile: !input restore_previous_profile
  respect_manual_changes: !input respect_manual_changes
  active_scene_id: "{{ 'myggspray_' ~ this.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_active' }}"
  active_scene_entity: "{{ 'scene.myggspray_' ~ this.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_active' }}"

trigger:
  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input motion_sensor
    to: "on"
    id: motion_on

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input motion_sensor
    to: "off"
    id: motion_off

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input motion_sensor
    to: "unavailable"
    for:
      seconds: 30
    id: motion_fault

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input motion_sensor
    to: "unknown"
    for:
      seconds: 30
    id: motion_fault

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input target_lights
    id: target_changed

  - platform: state
    entity_id: !input target_lights
    to: "unavailable"
    for:
      seconds: 30
    id: light_fault

condition: []

action:
  - choose:
      - alias: Track normal profiles and manual OFF
        conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: "{{ trigger.id == 'target_changed' }}"
        sequence:
          - choose:
              - alias: OFF means the motion session no longer owns the lights
                conditions:
                  - condition: template
                    value_template: >
                      {{ active_scene_entity in
                         (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}
                  - condition: template
                    value_template: >
                      {{ trigger.to_state is not none
                         and trigger.to_state.state == 'off' }}
                sequence:
                  - action: scene.delete
                    continue_on_error: true
                    target:
                      entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"

              - alias: Remember a normal ON profile while idle
                conditions:
                  - condition: template
                    value_template: "{{ restore_previous_profile }}"
                  - condition: template
                    value_template: >
                      {{ active_scene_entity not in
                         (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}
                  - condition: template
                    value_template: >
                      {{ trigger.to_state is not none
                         and trigger.to_state.state == 'on' }}
                sequence:
                  - variables:
                      profile_scene_id: >
                        {{ 'myggspray_' ~ this.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_'
                           ~ trigger.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_profile' }}
                  - action: scene.create
                    continue_on_error: true
                    data:
                      scene_id: "{{ profile_scene_id }}"
                      snapshot_entities:
                        - "{{ trigger.entity_id }}"

      - alias: Start motion lighting
        conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: "{{ trigger.id == 'motion_on' }}"
        sequence:
          - alias: Recover stale ownership if every target light is already off
            if:
              - condition: template
                value_template: >
                  {{ active_scene_entity in
                     (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list)
                     and (target_lights | count) > 0
                     and (expand(target_lights)
                          | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off')
                          | list | count) == 0 }}
            then:
              - action: scene.delete
                continue_on_error: true
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"

          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ active_scene_entity not in
                 (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}

          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ (expand(motion_sensors)
                   | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on')
                   | list | count) > 0 }}

          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {% set ns = namespace(below_threshold=false) %}
              {% for sensor in expand(illuminance_sensors) %}
                {% if is_number(sensor.state)
                      and (sensor.state | float) < (lux_threshold | float(0)) %}
                  {% set ns.below_threshold = true %}
                {% endif %}
              {% endfor %}
              {{ ns.below_threshold }}

          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ (target_lights | count) > 0
                 and (expand(target_lights)
                      | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off')
                      | list | count) == 0 }}

          - condition: and
            conditions: !input extra_activation_conditions

          - alias: Lock profile tracking for this session
            action: scene.create
            continue_on_error: true
            data:
              scene_id: "{{ active_scene_id }}"
              snapshot_entities: >
                {{ expand(motion_sensors)
                   | map(attribute='entity_id') | list }}

          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ active_scene_entity in
                 (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}

          - alias: Apply brightness and colour in one turn-on call
            choose:
              - conditions:
                  - condition: template
                    value_template: "{{ automation_colour_mode == 'rgb' }}"
                sequence:
                  - action: light.turn_on
                    continue_on_error: true
                    target:
                      entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"
                    data:
                      brightness_pct: "{{ automation_brightness_pct }}"
                      rgb_color: "{{ automation_rgb_colour }}"
                      transition: "{{ automation_turn_on_transition }}"

              - conditions:
                  - condition: template
                    value_template: "{{ automation_colour_mode == 'temperature' }}"
                sequence:
                  - action: light.turn_on
                    continue_on_error: true
                    target:
                      entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"
                    data:
                      brightness_pct: "{{ automation_brightness_pct }}"
                      color_temp_kelvin: "{{ automation_colour_temperature }}"
                      transition: "{{ automation_turn_on_transition }}"

            default:
              - action: light.turn_on
                continue_on_error: true
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"
                data:
                  brightness_pct: "{{ automation_brightness_pct }}"
                  transition: "{{ automation_turn_on_transition }}"

          - wait_template: >
              {{ (expand(target_lights) | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on')
                  | list | count) == (target_lights | count) }}
            timeout:
              seconds: 5
            continue_on_timeout: true

          - alias: Abort cleanly if a target light failed to report ON
            if:
              - condition: template
                value_template: "{{ not wait.completed }}"
            then:
              - action: light.turn_off
                continue_on_error: true
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"
              - action: scene.delete
                continue_on_error: true
                target:
                  entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"
              - stop: One or more target lights failed to report ON.

          - alias: Wait for normal cleanup, with a maximum-runtime failsafe
            wait_template: >
              {{ active_scene_entity not in
                 (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}
            timeout: !input maximum_runtime
            continue_on_timeout: true

          - alias: Stop this failsafe run if the session already ended normally
            if:
              - condition: template
                value_template: "{{ wait.completed }}"
            then:
              - stop: Motion-light session ended before maximum runtime.

          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ active_scene_entity in
                 (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}

          - alias: Restore remembered profiles before maximum-runtime OFF
            if:
              - condition: template
                value_template: "{{ restore_previous_profile }}"
            then:
              - repeat:
                  for_each: "{{ target_lights }}"
                  sequence:
                    - variables:
                        remembered_scene_entity: >
                          {{ 'scene.myggspray_' ~ this.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_'
                             ~ repeat.item.split('.')[1] ~ '_profile' }}
                    - if:
                        - condition: template
                          value_template: >
                            {{ remembered_scene_entity in
                               (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}
                      then:
                        - action: scene.turn_on
                          continue_on_error: true
                          target:
                            entity_id: "{{ remembered_scene_entity }}"
                          data:
                            transition: 0

          - action: light.turn_off
            continue_on_error: true
            target:
              entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"

          - action: scene.delete
            continue_on_error: true
            target:
              entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"

      - alias: End motion lighting after continuous clear time
        conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: "{{ trigger.id == 'motion_off' }}"
        sequence:
          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ active_scene_entity in
                 (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}

          - alias: Start the countdown only when every motion detector is clear
            condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ (expand(motion_sensors) | list | count) > 0
                 and (expand(motion_sensors)
                      | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off')
                      | list | count) == 0 }}

          - alias: Remember when each motion detector became clear
            variables:
              clear_state_signature: >
                {% set ns = namespace(parts=[]) %}
                {% for sensor in expand(motion_sensors)
                     | sort(attribute='entity_id') %}
                  {% set ns.parts = ns.parts +
                     [sensor.entity_id ~ '=' ~ sensor.last_changed] %}
                {% endfor %}
                {{ ns.parts | join('|') }}

          - delay: !input no_motion_duration

          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ (expand(motion_sensors) | list | count) > 0
                 and (expand(motion_sensors)
                      | rejectattr('state', 'eq', 'off')
                      | list | count) == 0 }}

          - alias: Ignore an old countdown if any detector changed state
            condition: template
            value_template: >
              {% set ns = namespace(parts=[]) %}
              {% for sensor in expand(motion_sensors)
                   | sort(attribute='entity_id') %}
                {% set ns.parts = ns.parts +
                   [sensor.entity_id ~ '=' ~ sensor.last_changed] %}
              {% endfor %}
              {{ ns.parts | join('|') == clear_state_signature }}

          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ active_scene_entity in
                 (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}

          - alias: Restore remembered profiles before automatic OFF
            if:
              - condition: template
                value_template: "{{ restore_previous_profile }}"
            then:
              - repeat:
                  for_each: "{{ target_lights }}"
                  sequence:
                    - variables:
                        remembered_scene_entity: >
                          {{ 'scene.myggspray_' ~ this.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_'
                             ~ repeat.item.split('.')[1] ~ '_profile' }}
                    - if:
                        - condition: template
                          value_template: >
                            {{ remembered_scene_entity in
                               (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}
                      then:
                        - action: scene.turn_on
                          continue_on_error: true
                          target:
                            entity_id: "{{ remembered_scene_entity }}"
                          data:
                            transition: 0

          - action: light.turn_off
            continue_on_error: true
            target:
              entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"

          - action: scene.delete
            continue_on_error: true
            target:
              entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"

      - alias: Clean up safely after a sensor or light fault
        conditions:
          - condition: template
            value_template: "{{ trigger.id in ['motion_fault', 'light_fault'] }}"
        sequence:
          - condition: template
            value_template: >
              {{ active_scene_entity in
                 (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}

          - alias: Restore remembered profiles before fault cleanup
            if:
              - condition: template
                value_template: "{{ restore_previous_profile }}"
            then:
              - repeat:
                  for_each: "{{ target_lights }}"
                  sequence:
                    - variables:
                        remembered_scene_entity: >
                          {{ 'scene.myggspray_' ~ this.entity_id.split('.')[1] ~ '_'
                             ~ repeat.item.split('.')[1] ~ '_profile' }}
                    - if:
                        - condition: template
                          value_template: >
                            {{ remembered_scene_entity in
                               (states.scene | map(attribute='entity_id') | list) }}
                      then:
                        - action: scene.turn_on
                          continue_on_error: true
                          target:
                            entity_id: "{{ remembered_scene_entity }}"
                          data:
                            transition: 0

          - action: light.turn_off
            continue_on_error: true
            target:
              entity_id: "{{ target_lights }}"

          - action: scene.delete
            continue_on_error: true
            target:
              entity_id: "{{ active_scene_entity }}"

A simple safety-net blueprint for lights that have been left on.

Created by @0libote
GitHub: https://github.com/0libote/HA-BPs

Behaviour:
- Never turns lights on and never changes brightness, colour, scenes, or
  other automation state.
- Supports one or multiple motion, occupancy, or presence sensors.
- Starts the safety countdown only when every selected presence sensor is
  clear, and turns the selected lights off only if every sensor stays clear
  for the entire configured time.
- If a selected light is turned on while the area is already clear, starts
  a fresh safety countdown and only acts if all sensors remain clear for
  that entire countdown.
- If Home Assistant restarts while the area is clear, starts a fresh safety
  countdown rather than immediately switching anything off.
- Motion or occupancy returning on any selected sensor during a safety
  countdown prevents that countdown from switching the lights off.
- Unknown or unavailable sensors are treated as not clear, so a sensor fault
  cannot cause an automatic switch-off.

This blueprint is intentionally passive. It does not try to own the lights
or replace your existing lighting automations. It is just a final
"forgot to turn it off" safety net.

## Forgot to Turn Off
Forgot to Turn Off

[![Import blueprint](https://my.home-assistant.io/badges/blueprint_import.svg)](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/blueprint_import/?blueprint_url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2F0libote%2FHA-BPs%2Fblob%2Fmain%2Fblueprints%2Fforgot-to-turn-off.yaml)

Manual import URL:

```text
https://github.com/0libote/HA-BPs/blob/main/blueprints/forgot-to-turn-off.yaml
```

This is a passive safety net for lights controlled manually or by other
automations. It never turns a light on or changes brightness, colour, scenes or
another automation.

### Configure

1. Import the blueprint and select **Create automation**.
2. Select one or more motion, occupancy or presence sensors for the area.
3. Select the lights that may be switched off.
4. Choose how long every sensor must remain clear, then save and test.

The countdown restarts safely after Home Assistant starts or a selected light
is turned on while the area is already clear. Unknown or unavailable sensors
are treated as occupied so a sensor fault cannot cause an automatic switch-off.

### Troubleshooting

- Lights remain on: confirm every selected sensor is `off`; unknown or
  unavailable sensors intentionally block switch-off.
- Lights turn off later than expected: activity on any selected sensor cancels
  that countdown, and the full delay starts again once every sensor is clear.
- Test with a short timeout first, then restore the intended safety duration.

        target_lights:
          name: Lights to Turn Off

              multiple: true

trigger:

  - alias: Remember exactly when each sensor became clear

        {% for sensor in expand(presence_sensors) | sort(attribute='entity_id') %}
          {% set ns.parts = ns.parts +
             [sensor.entity_id ~ '=' ~ sensor.last_changed] %}

        {{ ns.parts | join('|') }}
